observations.seen: Ceiling strip lights produce soft glows on the back walls and a warm pool on the floor in frame 4, but the walls are mostly flat-lit with weak falloff. Frame 3 is murky teal with low contrast.
Wall-floor junctions have no contact shadows or AO, and the enemy statues cast no visible shadows. The corridors read as unshadowed boxes.
The water plane in the flooded cellars is a flat opaque teal slab with no reflection or refraction. The floors show only a faint highlight blob.
Levels are long rectangular box corridors with yellow baseboard strips and no props, pipes, doors or bunker detail. The 'B-3 FORGE HALLS' floor decal is the only set dressing.
There is slight distance haze and bloom-like light glare, plus some sparkle particles in frame 2. There is no dust, steam, or volumetric light.
The stone wall texture in the cellars is decent but stretched and repeats. The concrete walls in frame 1 are low-frequency smudge with no normal detail, and the floors are blurry noise.
The pistol viewmodel is detailed with emissive accents, but enemies are distant dark silhouettes. A white floor quad in frame 1 looks like a misplaced placeholder.
Symmetric corridor framing gives a clear vanishing point, but frames lack focal interest. Frames 1 and 2 have no viewmodel at all.
The FOV is reasonable. The weapon sits oddly low-right and floats detached from any hand, and the HUD frames lack a viewmodel entirely.
There is mild bloom on the lights and a light vignette. Grading is monochrome per level, and frame 3 looks crushed and muddy.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
